user.title: Add a Helty Flow unit
user.description:
**Is the unit already connected to the home Wi-Fi?**

The first unit is always called «master»; for the others the name is read from the unit. The integration installs the VMC Master package in the folder packages/vmc_helty_flow/‹name›: after restarting Home Assistant add the «VMC Master» card from the dashboard.

menu_options.in_rete: Yes, it is connected: I only enter the IP
menu_options.da_installare: No, it must be set up from scratch (without the Air Guard app)
menu_options.riprendi: Continue with the unit just connected ({rete_vmc}, IP {ip})

in_rete.title: Unit already on the Wi-Fi
in_rete.description: Enter the IP address of the unit: it is shown in the router's device list. Reserving it on the router as a fixed IP is recommended.

nome.title: Unit name in the integration
nome.description:
Name read from the unit at {ip}: «{nome_vmc}». In the integration it becomes «{proposta}».

This name is part of every entity name (sensor.vmc_‹name›_…) and of the package folder, and cannot be changed later without losing the history: confirm it with Submit or correct it (lowercase letters only, 1 to 10 characters; «master» is reserved for the first unit).

nome_manuale.title: Unit name in the integration
nome_manuale.description:
The name cannot be read from the unit at {ip} (it does not answer or does not send its name): type it here.

This name is part of every entity name (sensor.vmc_‹name›_…) and of the package folder, and cannot be changed later without losing the history (lowercase letters only, 1 to 10 characters; «master» is reserved for the first unit).

non_raggiungibile.title: Unit not reachable
non_raggiungibile.description:
The unit at {ip} does not answer on port 5001 or does not send its name.

You can add it anyway, for example if it is switched off now: press Submit. The IP can be changed later from the gear icon on the unit's row → «Change the unit's IP». If the unit is not on the home Wi-Fi yet, close this window, add it again («Add integration» for the first unit, «Add device» for the others) and choose «No, it must be set up from scratch».

migra.title: Manual installation found
migra.description:
The folder packages/vmc_helty_flow/{nome} already contains a manual installation of unit {nome}.

- IP entered: {ip}
- IP in the manual installation: {ip_trovato}

If they differ, close this window and repeat with the right IP.

If you continue, the folder is moved to `/config/vmc_master_backup` and replaced by the integration package. Entity names stay the same, so the history is kept.

1. Press Submit.
2. Delete the automation pasted by hand (otherwise two identical automations run after the restart).
3. Restart Home Assistant.
4. Remove the old manual card from the dashboard.

rete_vmc.title: Connect the unit to the home Wi-Fi

data_description.password_casa: Used only for the connection: it is not stored in the integration.
data_description.password_server: The server is now connected to the {rete_del_server} network. If the chosen home network is different, enter the {rete_del_server} password here: it is needed to bring the server back to that network. Check it carefully: with a wrong password the server does not go back to its network. It is not stored.

errore.title: Connection failed
errore.description:
{errore}

**Filter alarm LED** (sequence repeated every 4 seconds):

| Flashes | Error |
|---|---|
| 1 alternating with 2 fast | Wrong password |
| 2 fast | Wrong encryption or password (e.g. router in WEP) |
| 3 fast | Access point not found |
| 4 fast | Connection error |
| 5 fast | Disconnected (weak Wi-Fi signal) |
| 6 fast | No IP address (router DHCP) |

After errors 1 and 2 three times in a row the unit goes back to Access Point mode by itself.

**Wi-Fi reset** (the unit network password goes back to 12345678):
1. switch the unit off;
2. cut the power upstream;
3. restore the power **while holding the Night button**;
4. keep it pressed until all LEDs have flashed 7 times.

menu_options.rete_vmc: Correct the data and try again

ip_fisso.title: Unit connected: reserve the IP on the router

progress.cerca: Searching the VMC_xxxxxxxx Wi-Fi networks: a few seconds.
progress.collega:
Connecting the unit to the {rete_casa} network: 1 to 3 minutes.

The server Wi-Fi switches to the {rete_vmc} network for about a minute, then goes back as it was. If Home Assistant reaches the home network only through Wi-Fi, this page may lose the connection meanwhile: the procedure goes on anyway. If the window closes, open «Add integration» (first unit) or «Add device» (other units) again and choose «Continue with the unit just connected».
progress.verifica: Checking IP {ip}: the same unit must answer (up to 30 seconds).

error.nome_non_valido: Invalid name: lowercase letters only, 1 to 10 characters.
error.nome_in_uso: Name already used by another unit.
error.ip_non_valido:
Invalid IP: four numbers from 0 to 255 separated by dots, without leading zeros.
0.x.x.x, 127.x.x.x, 169.254.x.x and the addresses from 224.0.0.0 up are not allowed.
error.ip_in_uso: IP already used by another unit.
error.password_server_mancante: The server is now connected to the {rete_del_server} network, which differs from the chosen home network: enter the {rete_del_server} password in «Current server Wi-Fi password».
error.ip_non_risponde_riavvia: The unit does not answer at this IP. Switch it off and on from its switch so it takes the reserved IP, then press Submit again.
error.ip_altro_dispositivo: Another device or unit answers at this IP, not {nome_vmc}. Check the reservation on the router.

abort.senza_supervisor: Connecting a unit to the Wi-Fi from here needs Home Assistant OS (with the Supervisor) and a Wi-Fi adapter on the server. This Home Assistant has no Supervisor: connect the unit once with the Air Guard app, then add it again («Add integration» for the first unit, «Add device» for the others) and choose «Yes, it is connected».
abort.senza_wifi: Home Assistant OS finds no Wi-Fi adapter on the server. You need a computer with built-in Wi-Fi or a recognised USB Wi-Fi dongle (Settings → System → Network). Otherwise connect the unit once with the Air Guard app, then add it again («Add integration» for the first unit, «Add device» for the others) and choose «Yes, it is connected».
abort.already_in_progress: This unit is already being added in another window.

cambia_ip.title: Change the unit's IP
cambia_ip.description: New IP address of the unit: {titolo} must answer there. The package is updated and Home Assistant asks to restart.

elimina.title: Delete the unit
elimina.description:
Delete **{titolo}** only from Home Assistant or from the network too?

- **Only from Home Assistant**: the unit stays on the home Wi-Fi. To add it again only the IP is needed («Yes, it is connected»).
- **From the network too**: the unit leaves the home Wi-Fi and goes back to Access Point mode (its VMC_… network is visible again). To add it again: «No, it must be set up from scratch», or connect it first with the Air Guard app.

It is added again from «Add device» («Add integration» if no other unit is left).

In both cases the unit's folder goes to `/config/vmc_master_backup` and Home Assistant then needs a restart.

menu_options.elimina_solo_ha: Only from Home Assistant (stays on the home network)
menu_options.elimina_dalla_rete: From the network too (back to Access Point)

elimina_dalla_rete.title: Delete the unit from the network too

menu_options.elimina_solo_ha: Delete it only from Home Assistant (stays on the home network)

progress.access_point: Sending the Access Point command to the unit ({ip}) and waiting for it to leave the home Wi-Fi: one minute at most.

error.ip_non_valido:
Invalid IP: four numbers from 0 to 255 separated by dots, without leading zeros.
0.x.x.x, 127.x.x.x, 169.254.x.x and the addresses from 224.0.0.0 up are not allowed.
error.ip_in_uso: IP already used by another unit.
error.ip_non_risponde: The unit does not answer at this IP on port 5001. Check the IP; to save it anyway press Submit again.
error.ip_altro_dispositivo: A device that is not a unit answers at this IP (it does not send a unit name). Check the IP.
error.ip_nome_diverso: Unit «{nome_letto}» answers at this IP, not {titolo}. Check the IP. If the name was changed in the Air Guard app, press Submit again to save it.

abort.eliminata: {titolo} has been deleted from Home Assistant and stays on the home network. To finish, restart Home Assistant.
abort.eliminata_dalla_rete: {titolo} is back in Access Point mode (its VMC_… network is visible again) and has been deleted from Home Assistant. To finish, restart Home Assistant.

confirm.title: Restart Home Assistant
confirm.description: The VMC Master package files were installed or updated: a restart is needed to load them. Press Submit to restart now.

packages_non_abilitati.title: VMC Master: package of unit {nome} not loaded
packages_non_abilitati.description:
The unit's files are installed but Home Assistant does not load them. configuration.yaml must contain these lines:

```yaml
homeassistant:
  packages: !include_dir_named packages/
```

If the `homeassistant:` line is already there, add only the `packages:` line right below it, indented by two spaces. Save and restart Home Assistant.

voce_disabilitata.title: VMC Master: unit {nome} disabled but still active
voce_disabilitata.description:
The entry **{titolo}** is disabled, but the unit's package stays in `/config/packages` and Home Assistant loads it at every start: entities and automation keep working.

While disabled, the unit does not receive the integration updates and the «VMC Master» card is not shown.

- To use it again: enable the entry.
- To stop it: enable the entry, then gear icon → «Delete the unit».

ambiguous_device.message: More than one unit answers with the same name on the home network: the connection cannot be confirmed. Give the units different names and try again.

ambiguous_padding.message: The field cannot end with an asterisk: the unit uses the asterisk as padding.

ap_not_applied.message: The unit still answers on the home network: the switch to Access Point mode was not applied.

ap_unconfirmed.message: The unit no longer answers on the home network, but the server cannot see its unit network. Check with the smartphone; if it is missing, use the Wi-Fi reset.

ap_unreachable.message: The unit network cannot be reached. Check the unit network name and password, and that the unit is in Access Point mode.

back_to_access_point.message: The unit could not connect and went back to Access Point mode: usually a wrong password or an unsupported encryption (e.g. WEP). Check the home network name and password and try again.

communication_error.message: Communication error. Check that the unit and the Supervisor can be reached.

duplicate_name.message: The name is already used by another unit on the home network: choose a different one.

identity_unconfirmed.message: A device other than the expected unit answers at this IP (name or MAC). No command was sent. Check the MAC/IP reservation on the router.

in_corso.message: A procedure is already running. Wait for the result.

interrupted.message: Procedure interrupted. Check the restore status before trying again.

invalid_ap_password.message: Invalid unit network password: 8 to 32 characters (the factory one is 12345678).

invalid_ap_ssid.message: Enter the unit network name (VMC_xxxxxxxx), 32 characters at most.

invalid_ip.message: Invalid IP: use the local address of the unit.

invalid_mac.message: The MAC must contain 6 pairs of hexadecimal characters.

invalid_name.message: The new name must have 1 to 12 characters: letters without accents, digits, _ or -.

invalid_new_password.message: The new password must have 8 to 32 characters among letters without accents, digits and $ @ ! % ? &.

invalid_password.message: The home Wi-Fi password must have 8 to 32 characters.

invalid_restore_password.message: «Current server Wi-Fi password» must have 8 to 63 characters.

invalid_ssid.message: The home Wi-Fi network name must have 1 to 32 characters.

invalid_subnet.message: The search network must have the network/24 format.

invalid_vmc.message: The device does not answer like a Helty Air Guard unit.

mac_unavailable.message: The MAC was not detected on the home network: the new IP cannot be confirmed automatically. Check MAC and IP in the router's device list.

no_lan.message: No local network found. Check that the server is connected to the home network and try again.

no_wifi.message: The Supervisor finds no Wi-Fi adapter on the server.

password_unconfirmed.message: The new password was sent, but the server cannot connect to the unit network. Try from the smartphone with the new and the old password; if neither works, use the Wi-Fi reset (the password goes back to 12345678).

rename_refused.message: The unit did not confirm the new name.

rename_unconfirmed.message: The new name was sent, but the unit still answers with another name.

restore_failed.message: The server Wi-Fi did not go back to the previous network. The password of that network may be wrong. Try again or restart Home Assistant for the automatic restore.

restore_password_required.message: The server Wi-Fi is connected to another network: enter that network's password in «Current server Wi-Fi password». Nothing was changed.

same_password.message: The new password is the same as the current one.

scan_failed.message: The server Wi-Fi adapter did not return the network list. Type the unit network name as shown on the smartphone.

subnet_too_large.message: The local network is too large for the automatic search: 256 addresses at most (network/24).

supervisor_error.message: The Supervisor did not complete the network operation.

supervisor_unavailable.message: The Supervisor does not answer: Wi-Fi management needs Home Assistant OS with the Supervisor.

unsupported_encoding.message: Use ASCII characters only, without accented letters.

unsupported_restore.message: The current server Wi-Fi profile uses an unsupported authentication.

verification_timeout.message: The network was sent, but the unit was not found on the home network. Check the assigned IP on the router.

vmc_unreachable.message: The unit does not answer. Check that it is on, the IP and the reservation on the router.

wifi_socket.message: The chosen Wi-Fi adapter cannot be used to reach the unit.

worker_start.message: The procedure could not be started.
